eyebrow: SQL for Oracle Financials · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 23 · Investigating Financial Data

code:
SELECT s.vendor_name, i.invoice_num, i.invoice_date, ps.due_date,
       ps.amount_remaining,
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) - ps.due_date AS days_overdue
FROM ap_invoices_all i
INNER JOIN poz_suppliers s ON s.vendor_id = i.vendor_id
INNER JOIN ap_payment_schedules_all ps ON ps.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE i.payment_status_flag <> 'Y'
  AND ps.amount_remaining > 10000
  AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) - ps.due_date > 30
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC;
caption: amount_remaining, not invoice_amount — "over $10,000" means what's still outstanding.
